bio.en: My PhD research is on human milk flavor, and my master's research was on the Maillard reaction of beef tallow residue. I use GC-MS, GC-O, electronic nose and sensory evaluation for analysis, and build models with machine learning. The 8 online tools on this site cover common steps in flavor R&D: automated GC-MS data processing, odor and taste prediction for molecules, search for flavor ingredients and their substitutes, dairy flavor improvement, analysis of individual differences in odor perception, and lookup of key flavor compound literature and EU, China and US flavoring regulations.
bio.zh: 我的博士课题是关于母乳风味的研究，硕士是牛油渣的美拉德反应。平时用 GC-MS、GC-O、电子鼻和感官评价做分析，并通过机器学习进行建模。本站的 8 个在线工具覆盖风味研发的几个常见环节：GC-MS 数据自动整理，分子的气味和味觉预测，风味原料与其替代物的检索，乳品风味的改良，人群的嗅觉差异分析，以及关键风味物质的文献和欧盟、中国、美国香料法规查询。
